_about: Missions, one entry each (lane A4 part 2). A map with a mission starts it when played (maps.json "mission" names it; bot runs start one only with {"call": "start_mission"}). "areas" are spawn circles on the map (x, z in metres, radius); a spawn point is picked inside on dry ground, not on a roof. "waves" run in order: each spawns its groups ("enemy" from enemies.json, "count", "area"; a group is a pack that shares contacts), shows its "objective", and the next wave starts "delay_s" after the last unit of this one is destroyed, or at "after_s" from this wave's start if that comes first (0: only when cleared). "alerted": the wave was called in and arrives knowing roughly where the Juggernaut is. "win": every wave destroyed. "lose": the player's Juggernaut destroyed. Scripts: scripts/mission/mission.gd, HUD scripts/ui/mission_hud.gd, end screen scripts/ui/mission_end.gd.
